entries.topic: US-Iran talks, IAEA resolution, Israel's 13 June 2025 strikes and Iran's response

claims.text: Round 2 of Oman-mediated US-Iran talks held in Rome on Saturday 19 April 2025, about a week after a first round in Muscat; Iran called the Muscat talks indirect

Round 4 held in Muscat on 11 May 2025 (after a 26 April round in Oman); Araghchi: enrichment 'should definitely continue and there is no room for compromise'; US official: agreement 'to move forward'; Witkoff first suggested 3.67% then said 'An enrichment program can never exist in the state of Iran ever again'

Oman announced 21 May a fifth round in Rome on Friday (23 May); Araghchi: enrichment 'will continue — with or without an agreement'; Khamenei: 'I don't think nuclear talks with the U.S. will bring results'
12 June 2025 Oman FM Badr al-Busaidi: 'I am pleased to confirm the 6th round of Iran US talks will be held in Muscat this Sunday the 15th'; US reducing non-essential staff in region

Killed 13 June 2025: chief of staff Mohammad Bagheri, IRGC commander Hossein Salami, Khatam al-Anbiya HQ commander Gholamali Rashid, IRGC aerospace commander Amir Ali Hajizadeh; nuclear scientists Fereydoun Abbasi-Davani, Mohammad Mahdi Tehranchi, Abdolhamid Minouchehr, Ahmad Reza Zolfaghari, Amir Hossein Faghihi and others

Trump 12 June: 'I don't want them going in because, I mean, that would blow it'; 13 June Truth Social: 60-day ultimatum, 'Today is day 61', 'Now they have, perhaps, a second chance!'; declined to comment on US participation
Trump to ABC 13 June: 'I think it's been excellent'; 'We gave them a chance and they didn't take it'; 'there's more to come. A lot more'; 'next already planned attacks being even more brutal'

Rubio 12 June: 'Tonight, Israel took unilateral action against Iran. We are not involved in strikes against Iran'; Israel advised the US it believed the action necessary for self-defence; 'Iran should not target U.S. interests or personnel'
Fox's Jennifer Griffin: 'There were no surprises'; administration 'knew about the Israeli plans in advance'; WSJ reported Trump told Netanyahu 9 June not to strike

IDF 14 June: objective 'eliminating the existential Iranian threat ... the nuclear and missile threat'; claimed Iran built infrastructure for 'reconverting enriched uranium for clear military purposes'; striking over 150 targets; 3 killed, 76 injured in Israel previous day

ToI 24 June 2025: IDF figures ~550 ballistic missiles and ~1,000 drones; ~90% missile interception; at least 31 impacts in populated areas/infrastructure; 28 killed in Israel (all but one civilian); Health Ministry 3,238 hospitalised; >9,000 displaced; IDF says ~30 senior commanders and at least 15 scientists killed; Health Ministry of Iran at least 610 killed
AP 8 July 2025: Foundation of Martyrs head Saeed Ohadi said at least 1,060 killed, may reach 1,100; HRANA 1,190 killed incl. 436 civilians and 435 security forces, 4,475 wounded
19 June 2025 a missile hit Soroka Medical Centre, Beersheba; Netanyahu vowed to 'exact the full price'; IRNA said targets were IDF intelligence sites near the hospital at Gav-Yam Technology Park
Bat Yam 15 June: 9 killed, ~200 injured; Tamra 15 June: 4 women of one family killed; Weizmann Institute in Rehovot hit; Haifa Bazan refinery 16 June shut down
IRGC called its strikes 'Operation True Promise 3', 'in direct retaliation against Israeli aggression', targeting fuel and energy infrastructure
14 June 2025: Omani FM Albusaidi said the Muscat round planned for Sunday would not take place: 'But diplomacy and dialogue remain the only pathway to lasting peace'

entries.topic: Operation Midnight Hammer, assessments, Al Udeid, ceasefire, IAEA access and the stockpile

claims.text: Midnight Hammer: seven B-2s from Whiteman AFB flew ~18 hours; 14 GBU-57 MOPs on Fordow and Natanz; submarine fired more than two dozen Tomahawks at Isfahan ~5pm ET 21 June; >125 aircraft; ~75 precision weapons; Caine: 'extremely severe damage and destruction', final BDA 'will take some time'; Hegseth: 'not ... about regime change'

Trump address 21 June 2025, 10:02pm: objective 'the destruction of Iran's nuclear enrichment capacity'; facilities 'completely and totally obliterated'; 'either peace or there will be tragedy'; 'there are many targets left'; thanked Netanyahu

CNN etc. 24 June reported low-confidence preliminary DIA assessment of setback by 'mere months'; Ratcliffe 25 June: 'a body of credible intelligence indicates Iran's Nuclear Program has been severely damaged', facilities 'would have to be rebuilt over the course of years'; Gabbard: facilities 'destroyed'; FT: HEU stock largely intact per European officials; Trump at NATO: 'They said it could be limited or it could be very severe'
Lt Gen Jeffrey Kruse removed as DIA director Aug 2025, 'loss of confidence' per anonymous sources; no stated link to the Iran assessment; Pentagon did not comment
Parnell 2 July 2025: 'probably closer to two years'; Grossi: enrichment could resume within 'a matter of months', damage 'severe' but 'not total'
Trump statement 23 June 2025: 'NO Americans were harmed, and hardly any damage was done'

Axios 23 June: Qatar intercepted 14 Iranian missiles (one struck near the base, no casualties); Qatar and US warned in advance; Trump thanked Iran for 'early notice'; Iran's SNSC said number matched US bombs; Qatar condemned

Ceasefire 24 June 2025: Trump announced 'complete and total' ceasefire; White House official: Vance, Rubio, Witkoff used direct and indirect channels; Qatar played important role, Trump thanked Emir Tamim; Netanyahu: will respond forcefully to violations; 5 killed in Beersheba and 9 in Iran before truce took effect
24 June: Trump: Iran violated it 'but Israel violated it too'; Truth Social 'ISRAEL. DO NOT DROP THOSE BOMBS'
Majlis 25 June 2025 voted 221-0, one abstention, to suspend IAEA cooperation; Ghalibaf: IAEA 'put its international credibility up for auction'
Pezeshkian signed law 2 July 2025: inspections need SNSC approval; Iranian officials called 12 June resolution an 'excuse' for attacks; US: 'unacceptable'; Germany: 'disastrous signal'
Grossi (Fox, June 2025): 'We do not have information of the whereabouts of this material'
AP 12 Nov 2025: 440.9 kg of up-to-60% uranium (IAEA estimate); unverified since the June war; Cairo agreement early September halted after UN snapback; Iran: cooperation conditional on SNSC decision

ISIS analysis of IAEA 4 June 2026 report: last verified 440.9 kg as of 13 June 2025; IAEA 'cannot provide any information on the current size, composition or whereabouts'; some HEU stored in Esfahan tunnel complex; Cairo agreement 9 Sept 2025, terminated by Iran 20 Nov 2025; IAEA stopped verification after 28 Feb 2026; ISIS: 'Iran has no identifiable route to produce weapon-grade uranium'

entries.topic: Audit re-verification of Part Ten claims

claims.text: Audit re-fetch: B-2s left Whiteman 'around midnight on Friday' with 'minimal communications', ~18 hours; 14 MOPs on Fordo and Natanz; more than two dozen Tomahawks from a submarine at Isfahan; more than 125 aircraft; Caine: 'all three sites sustained extremely severe damage and destruction'

Audit re-fetch: 14 Iranian missiles intercepted by Qatari air defences; SNSC statement read by Axios as 'signaling a desire to de-escalate'; Qatar 'strongly condemned the Iranian attack and called for a return to the negotiating table'
Audit re-fetch: five killed in Beersheba and nine in Iran before the ceasefire, per local authorities; Qatar 'played an important role'; article does not mention Oman

Audit re-fetch: New Arab named six nuclear scientists killed 13 June 2025 (Abbasi-Davani, Tehranchi, Minouchehr, Zolfaghari, Faghihi, Motalibizadeh); Faghihi 'deputy head of the AEOI and head of the Institute of Nuclear Sciences'
Audit re-fetch: Araghchi said Iran could 'consider some limits on its dimensions, amount and level for trust building'
Audit re-fetch: Ohadi spoke on state television late Monday (7 July 2025); HRANA described as Washington-based

Audit re-fetch: after the Cairo deal Iran let the IAEA inspect undamaged facilities incl. Bushehr and the Tehran Research Reactor; damaged sites closed; Grossi: stockpile could allow as many as 10 bombs, which did not mean Iran had one

Audit re-fetch: 440.9 kg as of 13 June 2025 is an IAEA estimate (earlier figures verified); IAEA reported regular vehicular activity around the Isfahan tunnel complex entrance in February 2026 and asked for access; 'no identifiable route' is ISIS's own assessment
Audit re-fetch: Parnell did not explain how the two-year assessment was reached
Audit re-fetch: Netanyahu on X: Iran's 'terrorist tyrants' fired at Soroka; Israel would 'exact the full price from the tyrants in Tehran'
Audit re-fetch: Al Jazeera reported 2 July 2025, citing state TV, that Pezeshkian had signed the law; State Dept spokesperson Tammy Bruce called it 'unacceptable'
Audit re-fetch: Majlis vote Wednesday 25 June 2025: 221 in favour, one abstention, none against; required Guardian Council approval
